## 2026-09-22 — Q6.3: Naming conventions

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable, structure only — no prior domain's
term migrated into this one (unlike Data Platform's Database Naming
Convention migration), so no org-decision question needed.

**Answer:** Report/Dashboard naming includes a `[CERTIFIED]` prefix
making Certification Status visible in the title itself, deliberately
redundant with the metadata field, for at-a-glance legibility. Calculated
Field naming deliberately left loosely specified (tool casing varies) —
flagged as a looser convention than most others in this framework, for a
genuine reason.

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
